1. What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, improve the user experience, and provide information to the owners of the site.

2. How We Use Cookies

Marketio LLC uses cookies to: authenticate subscribers and keep them logged in; remember preferences (such as dashboard layouts and configuration selections); monitor platform health and performance; and assist with our marketing efforts (such as analyzing outreach response and tracking page performance).

3. Types of Cookies We Use

We categorize our cookies into three main groups:

3.1 Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the platform to function properly. Without them, you would not be able to log into secure areas of the Services, complete subscription payments, or maintain your session.

3.2 Performance and Analytics Cookies

These cookies collect aggregated information about how visitors interact with our Services. For example, we use Google Analytics to identify which pages are visited most frequently and detect any errors. These do not directly identify individual visitors.

3.3 Functional and Marketing Cookies

These cookies allow the site to remember choices you make (such as language or region preferences) and provide enhanced features. They are also used to deliver advertisements and outreach metrics relevant to your interests.

4. Managing Cookie Preferences

You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can set your browser to refuse all cookies or indicate when a cookie is being sent.

Please note that if you disable essential cookies, some parts of the Marketio Services or the dashboard may not function correctly.

5. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please re-visit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies.
